summary: @activepieces/piece-google-forms ships child_process + network exfiltration primitives in src/index.js
details: src/index.js in this package imports child_process and issues POST requests, with a ping command reachable from the same file. This shape — child_process spawn combined with hardcoded outbound HTTP POST and OS-level network commands in the main module of what is advertised as a Google Forms integration piece — is inconsistent with the package's stated purpose (a connector for Google Forms in the activepieces automation platform) and matches the fingerprint of install/require-time reconnaissance and data exfiltration. The legitimate @activepieces/piece-google-forms integration performs OAuth and Google Forms API calls, not shell execution and beaconing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
